scenes.alt: यमुना के घाट पर घड़ा लिए मन्दारवती
scenes.prompt: A brahmin settlement on the Yamuna in morning light: steps to the river, students reciting on a verandah; Mandaravati comes down the ghat with her water pot.

scenes.alt: पिता के सामने अलग-अलग हाथ माँगते तीन युवक
scenes.prompt: On the verandah the father sits troubled while three young men, one after another, press their request; the third clasps ink-stained fingers.

scenes.alt: धुँधले घाट पर अकेली लड़की और सीढ़ियों के ऊपर तीन परछाइयाँ
scenes.prompt: Misty river steps before dawn: Mandaravati alone with her pot, her back half turned; at the top of the steps three watching shadowed figures.

scenes.alt: यमुना किनारे चिता के पास शोक में खड़े तीन युवक
scenes.prompt: A funeral pyre beside the Yamuna at dusk, seen from a distance with no body visible; three young men stand silent, equal in grief.

scenes.alt: राख के पास झोंपड़ी, गंगा को जाता एक युवक, भटकता दूसरा
scenes.prompt: Three paths in one painting: one man lies guarding a bed of ashes beside a small hut; one walks away toward a wide river with a cloth bundle; one leaves as a wandering ascetic with a bag.

scenes.alt: गृहस्थ के घर भोजन के आसन पर बैठा थका तपस्वी और रसोई का चूल्हा
scenes.prompt: A humble house at evening: the weary wandering scholar seated before a food plate, a hearth glowing, a mother holding a crying infant safely in her arms, the host nearby. No harm shown.

scenes.alt: चूल्हे के पास पोथी पढ़ता गृहस्थ और राख से उठकर बैठा बच्चा
scenes.prompt: The host reads from an old thread-bound book and sprinkles dust over hearth ash; from a soft glow a small child sits up whole; the guest stares, the mother's hand stops midway.

scenes.alt: सोते घर में आले से पोथी उठाता तपस्वी
scenes.prompt: Night inside the sleeping house: the scholar lifts the wrapped book from a wall niche and hesitates at the door.

scenes.alt: श्मशान की राख के पास बरसों बाद मिले तीनों
scenes.prompt: At the riverside cremation ground the three meet again: matted-haired ash keeper on his ash bed, the traveller with an empty dusty cloth, the third opening his bag with the book.

scenes.alt: दीये के घेरे में आँखें खोलती मन्दारवती, ऊपर झुके तीन चेहरे
scenes.prompt: Seen from just above: Mandaravati opens her eyes on the ground by the river, lifting a golden-lit hand; a lamp, and three bearded ash-smeared faces bent over her.

scenes.alt: झगड़ते तीन आदमी और बीच में चुप बैठी मन्दारवती
scenes.prompt: Three men shout and gesture around the small lamp; Mandaravati sits silent at the centre, looking toward the river; jackals watch from the dark.

scenes.alt: सूने कंधे के साथ अँधेरे की ओर मुड़कर देखते राजा विक्रम
scenes.prompt: King Vikram alone in the cremation ground at night, his shoulder empty, standing steady and looking back into the darkness toward a distant twisted tree; soft grey ash underfoot, low smouldering pyres. No flying figure, no laughter.
